meaning:
§ Shaaraim = "double gate"
a town in Judah

elsewhere.note: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.
The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron. The wounded of the Philistines fell down…
at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.
